paragraphs.text: The Sea of Sand is a sun-blasted, interminable desert , somewhere in Rabiah .

In this desert, fate can decide if travelers will come upon a lush oasis or if they will merely trudge all day toward the shimmering mirage of one, which in the end, will be revealed to simply be more sand. If someone dares to enter the Sea of Sand, he's advised to bring a reliable compass, lest he becomes a bleached skeleton and then just a dune among infinite others.
